title: Utility back on path A: closed-transition retransfer with the synchroscope (training mode)
summary: TRAINING MODE, outside the A3 design (which retransfers in open transition). Path A is on generators and the utility is back. The generator bus runs fast and out of phase. Trim the governor until the slip is inside the window, close 52-U in parallel when the needle is inside +/-10 degrees (the ANSI 25 sync-check blocks the close otherwise; the controller then opens 52-GM), and stop the sets. An open-transition retransfer fails this drill.

steps.text: Acknowledge the path A alarms in the alarm banner
Trim the governor until the slip is within +/-0.10 Hz (MV transfer A: LOWER / RAISE)
Close 52-U in sync (MV transfer A: Closed-transition retransfer) with the needle in the window
Stop the generator bus (MV transfer A: Stop generator bus)

fail.reason: open-transition retransfer used: this drill asks for a closed transition
